claims.assertion: Yazhi views time as a nested, expanding network of simultaneous event paths; nexus points spread influence, while attention animates a sequence.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She describes all paths as interconnected, not isolated.

claims.assertion: Yazhi rejects automatic planetary ascension, describing ascension as individual growth of perception; aligned groups could form a society with a 5D mentality.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says collective change depends on human agreement.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says small actions accumulate into larger effects; humans themselves must change society rather than expect Federation rescue.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: This is her advice to the audience.
